pkTableName.description: Name of the table which the primary key candidate column is from.

fkTableName.description: Name of the table which the foreign key candidate column is from.

pkColumn.description: Name of the primary key column.

fkColumn.description: Name of the foreign key column. Column names are sourced from the keys of ObjDigest.fieldStats().

earthMoversDistance.description:
Earth Mover's Distance between the histograms of the primary and foreign key columns. This is an indication of how
good of a candidate this pair is; the lower the number, the more likely the relationship. This field may not behave
well for small amounts of data (< 1000). For String columns, this will be null.
@see NumericHistogram

name: InferredKeyPair
